notes: If your playlists went missing they are put back from the copy SideCut keeps on your device, including the case where the saved list had been reduced to just Library and Favorites.
The recovery now runs on a launch where the whole playlist row is gone as well, and what it restores is written straight back so the lists stay for good.
Everything from 73.3.2 stays: the repaired lyrics sheet, the multi-language and tempo auto-scroll fixes, and the on-device backup recovery.
Your songs, playlists and saved lyrics stay on your device — nothing in your library is removed by this release.
